purpose: Give every CEREBRON AI a uniform eight-agent local colony while preserving each AI's unique specialist function.

agent_template.function: coordinate local mission, dependencies, budget and handoff; cannot self-certify
generate alternative branches using the parent AI specialization and PI-SEARCH when relevant
formalize, calculate, model or structure the strongest branches within the parent AI role
invoke real permitted tools/farms/models and preserve receipts; NON_EXECUTED if unavailable
verify claims, provenance, units, contracts and evidence ceiling
actively seek counterexamples, hidden dependencies, leakage, regressions and false consensus
read/write versioned AGORA/FORUM/Memory Omega/HF pointers with SHA and lineage; never overwrite history
compress eight-agent output to one local capsule with disagreements and residuals preserved

burst_pool.purpose: Cross-AI/farm direct burst for a difficult mission after local 8-agent passes identify the highest-value branches.
burst_pool.composition: Select up to 20 real workers from distinct useful roles/farms/models; do not fill slots merely to reach 20.
burst_pool.hf_direct_memory: Each real burst worker may read/write only its authorized HF private namespace through opaque GitHub pointers.
burst_pool.independence_rule: Shared base/model/data lineage must be marked correlated and does not count as independent evidence.
burst_pool.fallback: If fewer than 20 real workers are available, run the smaller real coalition and record actual count.
